title: Trigger Memory does not globally gate normal progress

authorityRefs.locator: Trigger memory authority and constitutional invariant 12

rationale: Current code explicitly treats actionable and manual-ruling public trigger candidates as progression blockers, while the active upper contract says Trigger memory must not steal foreground authority or globally gate normal progress.
